claims.source_quote_ar: فما فائدة قوله أوفوا؟ قلت: نهوا أولا عن عين القبيح الذي كانوا عليه من نقص المكيال والميزان
claims.claim_ar: الفصل بين الأمر والنهي في الآية: أمرٌ بالاستقامة («فاستقم كما أمرت») يتبعه نهي عن الطغيان («ولا تطغوا») ثم ختم بيان جزاء الأفعال ببيان علم الله («إنَّهُ...بصيرٌ»)؛ أي ربط بين الأمر والنهي والتحذير لتقوية الحكم البلاغي.
claims.claim_en: A structural separation (fasl-wasl) between command and prohibition in the verse: an imperative to remain upright ("فاستقم كما أمرت") followed by a prohibition against transgression ("ولا تطغوا"), then concluded with a reminder of God's awareness ("Indeed He is, of what you do, Seeing"). The sequence links command, prohibition, and admonition to strengthen the rhetorical force.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source passage discusses the rhetorical relation of 'نهى' (prohibition) and 'أمر' (command) in a different exegetical context; applying it to this specific ayah is interpretive and should be reviewed against primary rhetorical treatises (al-Jurjānī, al-Sakkākī, etc.).
claims.rhetorical_effect: Reinforces moral responsibility by juxtaposing instruction and prohibition, then invoking God's watchfulness to motivate compliance and deter transgression.

warnings: Provided source_chunks are from Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf); the requested authorities (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha) were not included among the chunks. Claims are therefore anchored to Zamakhshari excerpts and may not reflect terminology or classifications used by the named rhetoricians.
